title: IAOMS Foundation Fellows and Visiting Scholars
html:
The IAOMS Foundation is proud to announce the 2026–2027 Foundation Program recipients, an exceptional group of oral and maxillofacial surgeons selected for advanced training and observership opportunities through the IAOMS Foundation Fellowship and Visiting Scholar programs.

Learn About Foundation Programs Support the Foundation 13 Program Recipients 10 Countries Represented 3 Continents as Training Sites 3 Advanced Fellowship Focus Areas

These programs connect surgeons from around the world with leading institutions and mentors in oral and maxillofacial surgery. Through immersive training in cleft lip and palate and craniofacial surgery, oncology and microvascular reconstruction, advanced orthognathic and TMJ surgery, and focused clinical observerships, recipients gain knowledge they can carry back to their institutions, patients, and communities.

Training that travels home.

The 2026–2027 cohort reflects the global reach and purpose of the IAOMS Foundation: expanding access to advanced education, strengthening specialty leadership, and supporting the next generation of OMS professionals worldwide.

Fellowship Recipients

IAOMS Foundation Fellowships provide advanced training opportunities in specialized areas of oral and maxillofacial surgery, helping recipients expand their expertise and strengthen care in their home communities.
